title: Saving Our Planet
text:
Our planet needs help. Many people throw away plastic bottles every day. These bottles can stay in the environment for hundreds of years.

Recycling is an easy way to help. When we put paper, glass and plastic in the right bin, factories can make new things from them. Trees are also important because they clean the air. Every small action makes a difference.

questions.text: How long can plastic bottles stay in the environment?
What can people put in the right bin to help?

options: They do not care about the planet
They want to help protect the environment

questions.text: What can we infer about the planet if people do nothing?

using old materials again to make new things
containers with a narrow neck, often made of glass or plastic
buildings where things are made in large numbers

paragraph_translations: Nosso planeta precisa de ajuda. Muitas pessoas jogam fora garrafas de plástico todos os dias. Essas garrafas podem permanecer no ambiente por centenas de anos.

A reciclagem é uma maneira fácil de ajudar. Quando colocamos papel, vidro e plástico na lixeira certa, as fábricas podem fazer coisas novas com eles. As árvores também são importantes porque limpam o ar. Cada pequena ação faz diferença.
